column1: Research in Britain has shown that green consumers’ continue to flourish as a significant group amongst shoppers.
column2: 在英国的研究显示，环保消费者作为购物者中的一个显著群体，其影响力持续增强。

column1: This suggests that politicians who claim environmentalism is yesterday’s issue may be seriously misjudging the public mood.
column2: 这表明，那些认为环保主义已成过时议题的政治家，可能严重误判了公众情绪。

column1: A report from Mintel, the market research organisation, says that despite the recession and financial pressures, more people than ever want to buy environmentally friendly products and a ‘green wave’ has swept through consumerism, taking in people previously untouched by environmental concerns.
column2: 市场研究机构Mintel的一份报告指出，尽管面临经济衰退和财务压力，越来越多的人希望购买环保产品，一场‘绿色浪潮’已席卷消费领域，覆盖了此前对环境问题漠不关心的群体。

column1: The recently published report also predicts that the process will repeat itself with ‘ethical’ concerns, involving issues such as fair trade with the Third World and the social record of businesses.
column2: 最新发布的报告还预测，这一过程将因‘伦理’问题再次发生，涉及与第三世界国家的公平贸易以及企业社会记录等问题。

column1: Companies will have to be more honest and open in response to this mood.
column2: 企业必须更加诚实和透明，以回应这种趋势。

column1: Mintel’s survey, based on nearly 1,000 consumers, found that the proportion who look for green products and are prepared to pay more for them has climbed from 53 per cent in 1990 to around 60 per cent in 1994.
column2: 根据Mintel的调查，基于近1000名消费者的样本，寻求绿色产品并愿意为此多支付的消费者比例，从1990年的53%上升至1994年的约60%。

column1: On average, they will pay 13 per cent more for such products, although this per centage is higher among women, managerial and professional groups and those aged 35 to 44.
column2: 平均而言，他们为这类产品支付的价格将高出13%。尽管这一比例在女性、管理层和专业人士以及35至44岁人群中更高。

column1: Between 1990 and 1994 the proportion of consumers claiming to be unaware of or unconcerned about green issues fell from 18 to 10 per cent but the number of green spenders among older people and manual workers has risen substantially.
column2: 1990年至1994年间，声称不了解或对绿色问题漠不关心的消费者比例从18%降至10%，但老年人和体力劳动者中绿色消费的人数显著上升。

column1: Regions such as Scotland have also caught up with the south of England in their environmental concerns.
column2: 像苏格兰这样的地区，在环保问题上的关注水平已赶上英格兰南部。

column1: According to Mintel, the image of green consumerism as associated in the past with the more eccentric members of society has virtually disappeared.
column2: 根据Mintel的数据显示，过去将绿色消费主义与社会中较为另类、独特群体关联的形象几乎已消失。

column1: The consumer research manager for Mintel, Angela Hughes, said it had become firmly established as a mainstream market.
column2: Mintel的消费者研究经理安吉拉·休斯表示，这一市场已牢固确立为主流市场。

column1: She explained that as far as the average person is concerned environmentalism has not gone off the boil’.
column2: 她解释说，对于普通人来说，环保主义的热情并未降温。

column1: In fact, it has spread across a much wider range of consumer groups, ages and occupations.
column2: 事实上，它已扩展到更广泛的消费者群体、不同年龄和职业层面。

column1: Mintel’s 1994 survey found that 13 per cent of consumers are ‘very dark green’, nearly always buying environmentally friendly products, 28 per cent are ‘dark green’, trying ‘as far as possible’ to buy such products, and 21 per cent are ‘pale green’ – tending to buy green products if they see them.
column2: Mintel在1994年进行的一项调查显示，有13%的消费者倾向于购买‘非常深的绿色’产品，他们几乎总是选择环保产品；28%的消费者属于‘深绿色’偏好型，会尽可能购买这类产品；而21%的消费者则属于‘浅绿色’类型，他们在看到绿色产品时通常会选择购买。

column1: Another 26 per cent are ‘armchair greens’; they said they care about environmental issues but their concern does not affect their spending habits.
column2: 又有26%的人是‘沙发绿’，他们表示关心环境问题，但这种关心并未影响他们的消费习惯。

column1: Only 10 per cent say they do not care about green issues.
column2: 只有10%的人表示他们不关心环保问题。

column1: Four in ten people are ‘ethical spenders’, buying goods which do not, for example, involve dealings with oppressive regimes.
column2: 四成的人是‘道德消费者’，他们购买的商品不涉及与专制政权的交易。

column1: This figure is the same as in 1990, although the number of ‘armchair ethicals’ has risen from 28 to 35 per cent and only 22 per cent say they are unconcerned now, against 30 per cent in 1990.
column2: 这一数字与1990年相同，但‘扶手椅式伦理者’的比例从28%上升至35%，如今只有22%的人表示漠不关心，而1990年这一比例是30%。

column1: Hughes claims that in the twenty-first century, consumers will be encouraged to think more about the entire history of the products and services they buy, including the policies of the companies that provide them and that this will require a greater degree of honesty with consumers.
column2: 休斯认为，在21世纪，消费者将被鼓励更深入地了解他们所购买的产品和服务的整个历史，包括提供这些产品和服务的公司的政策。这就要求企业必须更加诚实地与消费者沟通。

column1: Among green consumers, animal testing is the top issue – 48 per cent said they would be deterred from buying a product it if had been tested on animals -followed by concerns regarding irresponsible selling, the ozone layer, river and sea pollution, forest destruction, recycling and factory farming.
column2: 在绿色消费者中，动物测试是首要问题——48%的人表示如果产品曾经过动物测试，就会拒绝购买；其次是关于不负责任的销售、臭氧层破坏、河流和海洋污染、森林砍伐、回收问题以及工厂养殖的担忧。

column1: However, concern for specific issues is lower than in 1990, suggesting that many consumers feel that Government and business have taken on the environmental agenda.
column2: 不过，对特定问题的关注程度低于1990年时的水平，这表明许多消费者认为政府和企业在环保问题上已经采取了足够的行动。
